name: Goldie Fenn
perk: Goldie gives you 10% off tools and buildings
lines: Need anything, dear? The store's always open.
Tobias used to grow strawberries like rubies. Just saying.
You're a natural. Don't let it go to your head.
I put a little something aside for you. Kidding! Mostly.
Honestly, the valley feels alive again. That's you, you know.
I told Tobias you're doing wonderfully. He wrote back with three exclamation marks.
You're family now. I don't say that to everyone. I say it to most people, but I mean it with you.
When the market's full again, the first pie is yours.

name: Bruno Okafor
lines: Measure twice, cut once. My father said that. He was always late.
Need something built? I'm your man.
That fence of yours is holding up nicely. Good posts.
Corn makes the best bread. Fight me. Politely.
I carved a little sign for your gate. It's not done. It'll be done.
Rufus smiled at me yesterday. I think. Hard to tell with the beard.
You know what I like about you? You finish things.
Whatever this valley needs next, count me in.

name: Rufus Hale
perk: Rufus mills faster for you: the mill gets a free extra slot
lines: Hmph.
Don't track mud in the mill.
Wheat's looking decent. Decent. Don't make a thing of it.
Twenty years that wheel sat still. Don't make me wait twenty more for good wheat.
...Thank you. For the mill. There. I said it.
Tobias and I used to race grain carts down that hill. I won. He says he won. He's wrong.
You can call me Ru. Nobody calls me Ru. Don't call me Ru in front of Bruno.
Bring me flour sacks and I'll tell you stories. Short ones.

name: Pip Rowan
perk: Pip shares her tricks: your bakery works 25% faster
lines: Sorry! I mean, hello. I always start with sorry.
Is it too early to be thinking about pie? It's never too early.
I tried a new recipe and only burned half of it. Progress!
Your wheat smells like summer. Is that weird to say? It's weird.
I saved you the crispy end. Everyone wants the crispy end. You get it.
Goldie says I worry too much. I worry that's true.
You're my favourite customer. Don't tell the others. Actually, they know.
When I'm nervous now, I think about your farm. All those neat little rows.

name: Ziggy Marlowe
perk: Ziggy gives you a friend's price: 10% off his cart
lines: Everything on this cart has a story. Some of them are even true!
Rare seeds, dear farmer. Rarer than an honest merchant. Present company excepted.
You again! My favourite face in the valley. Don't tell Goldie.
I once sold a pumpkin to a king. A small king. A king of a very small hill.
Between you and me, the gold nuggets come from a river. A very specific river. I'll never tell.
Bramblewick was a ghost town when I first rolled through. Look at it now.
I don't usually stay anywhere long. I might make an exception for this place.
For you, the secret stock. There is no secret stock. Or is there.
